event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: Arnd Howar, from Earlybird, attended the hearing as an observer.
The technical committee was represented by Zoran Grubisa.
EarlyBird was represented by Manuel Weiller.
facts: On July 29th Early Bird ITA 3176 was selected for a post-race measurement flotation check.
Freeboard measurements were FFM = 0.833m and FAM = 0.668m with SG = 1.025, which gave a new displacement of 1907 kg, that is 29 kg less than the displacement recorded in the original certificate.
The original certificate had an APH of 493.8
The technical committee measured the righting moment as 72.8 kgm, which is 0.1 kgm less than the righting moment recorded in the original certificate.
A test certificate was run with new freeboard and stability measurements resulting in APH of 492.7 s/NM that is 1.1 s/NM faster than the original certificate.
The difference between the new and the old APH is 0.223%.
conclusions: Since the difference in APH is greater than 0.1% and smaller than 0.25%, ORC 305.2(b) applies.
decision: A new certificate shall be issued based on the new measurement data and all races of the series shall be rescored using the new certificate data.
